_comment: Source of truth for the in-app About → Licenses screen (sc-3778). License text lives alongside each entry in this directory; build-sidecar.mjs stages the bundled-binary files (ffmpeg/onnxruntime/cuda) next to the corresponding binaries in the packaged app. Model entries (sc-5604) are notice-only — they record the upstream license + attribution for AI model weights SceneWorks re-hosts on its Hugging Face org and downloads at runtime; they are not staged as binaries. The `description` below is shown to end users — keep it user-facing.
description: SceneWorks bundles the third-party binaries listed below, and redistributes the AI model weights listed below — downloaded on first use from the SceneWorks model repository on Hugging Face. The upstream attributions, license notices, and any written offers are reproduced here.

components.name: FFmpeg
components.usage: Bundled static binary (macOS arm64), invoked as a separate program for video/audio encode, mux, frame sampling and timeline export.

components.name: ONNX Runtime
components.usage: Bundled CoreML dynamic library (macOS arm64), loaded at runtime for the in-app DWPose pose detector.

components.name: NVIDIA CUDA Runtime Libraries
components.usage: Bundled CUDA runtime redistributable DLLs (cudart, cuBLAS, cuBLAS Lt, cuRAND, NVRTC), loaded at runtime by the native candle (CUDA) generation backend. Requires an NVIDIA GPU and display driver 576.02 or newer.

components.name: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B (MLX)
components.usage: Text/image-to-video model. On Apple Silicon, SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted MLX copy of the upstream Apache-2.0 weights, re-hosted at SceneWorks/wan2.2-ti2v-5b-mlx. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0.

components.name: Wan2.2-I2V-A14B (MLX)
components.usage: Image-to-video mixture-of-experts model. On Apple Silicon, SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted MLX copy of the upstream Apache-2.0 weights, re-hosted at SceneWorks/wan2.2-i2v-a14b-mlx. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0.

components.name: Wan2.2-T2V-A14B (MLX)
components.usage: Text-to-video mixture-of-experts model. On Apple Silicon, SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted MLX copy of the upstream Apache-2.0 weights, re-hosted at SceneWorks/wan2.2-t2v-a14b-mlx. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0.

components.name: LTX-2.3 + Gemma-3-12B (MLX)
components.usage: Text/image-to-video model with audio. On Apple Silicon, SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted MLX bundle re-hosted at SceneWorks/ltx-2.3-mlx, containing the LTX-2.3 video weights (LTX-2 Community License) plus a Gemma-3-12B text encoder (Google Gemma Terms of Use). These are restricted licenses, not permissive — both notices below apply.

components.name: LTX-2.3 IC-LoRA HDR and LipDub
components.usage: LTX-2.3 HDR and LipDub/DubIt IC-LoRA adapters downloaded on first use from the immutable public SceneWorks/ltx-2.3-ic-loras rehost. The rehost contains the exact unmodified upstream HDR adapter, its companion scene embedding, and the LipDub/DubIt adapter; SceneWorks currently downloads the two adapters and does not consume the scene embedding. These derivatives remain subject to the complete LTX-2 Community License, including its use restrictions and paid-license requirement for entities at or above its annual-revenue threshold.

documents.label: SceneWorks redistribution notice and immutable provenance

components.name: Kokoro-82M (Speech)
components.usage: Text-to-speech model (Audio Studio → Speech). SceneWorks downloads the upstream Apache-2.0 weights on first use from hexgrad/Kokoro-82M and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 (SFX)
components.usage: Text-to-audio sound-effect / ambience model (Audio Studio → SFX). SceneWorks downloads the upstream Apache-2.0 weights on first use from OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-SoundEffect-v2.0 and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: ACE-Step v1.5 XL Turbo (Music)
components.usage: Text-to-music model with prompted audio editing (Audio Studio → Music). SceneWorks downloads the upstream MIT weights on first use from ACE-Step/acestep-v15-xl-turbo-diffusers and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Ships its own Oobleck VAE (no Stability-licensed component). Redistributed with attribution as permitted by MIT. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: ACE-Step v1.5 XL SFT (Cover restyle)
components.usage: Cover-restyle checkpoint for the ACE-Step Music model (Audio Studio → Music → Cover). SceneWorks downloads the upstream MIT weights on first use as a co-requisite of ACE-Step v1.5 XL Turbo, from ACE-Step/acestep-v15-xl-sft-diffusers — the non-distilled reference cover DiT (transformer) plus the FSQ audio_tokenizer and audio_token_detokenizer conditioning modules — and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Used only for the Cover edit mode; text-to-music and the inpaint/repaint/extend edits use the Turbo weights above. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by MIT. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: OpenVoice V2 (Voice Conversion)
components.usage: Tone-color voice-conversion model (Audio Studio → VoiceClone). SceneWorks downloads the upstream MIT converter weights on first use from myshell-ai/OpenVoiceV2 and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by MIT. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: Chatterbox (Cloned-Voice TTS)
components.usage: Native cloned-voice text-to-speech model (Audio Studio → VoiceClone). SceneWorks downloads the upstream MIT primary weights on first use from ResembleAI/chatterbox — the T3 speech-token LM (t3_cfg.safetensors) and the S3Gen flow-matching token→waveform + HiFTNet vocoder stack (s3gen.safetensors) — and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Uses the Chatterbox voice encoder (listed separately below) for speaker conditioning. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by MIT. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: Chatterbox Voice Encoder (Voice Clone)
components.usage: Speaker voice-identity encoder for cloned-voice conditioning (Audio Studio → VoiceClone). SceneWorks downloads the upstream MIT ve.safetensors weights on first use from ResembleAI/chatterbox and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by MIT. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: Perth Watermarker (Chatterbox provenance)
components.usage: Perceptual-threshold (Perth) implicit audio watermarker that embeds a provenance watermark into every Chatterbox cloned-voice render (Audio Studio → VoiceClone). SceneWorks downloads the upstream MIT perth_implicit.safetensors weights on first use as a pinned co-requisite of the Chatterbox Cloned-Voice TTS model, re-hosted at SceneWorks/perth-implicit, and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by MIT. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: MOSS-TTSD v0.5 (Multi-Speaker Dialogue)
components.usage: Multi-speaker / long-form dialogue text-to-speech model (Audio Studio → Speech). SceneWorks downloads the upstream Apache-2.0 AR weights on first use from OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-TTSD-v0.5 and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Requires the XY_Tokenizer codec (listed separately below) as a pinned co-requisite. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: XY_Tokenizer (MOSS-TTSD codec)
components.usage: RVQ delay-pattern audio codec that decodes MOSS-TTSD v0.5's frames into a 24 kHz waveform (Audio Studio → Speech). SceneWorks downloads the upstream Apache-2.0 xy_tokenizer.ckpt on first use from OpenMOSS-Team/XY_Tokenizer_TTSD_V0 as a pinned co-requisite of MOSS-TTSD v0.5 and runs it natively (Candle) on every platform. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: MOSS-TTS-Realtime (Streaming Speech)
components.usage: Streaming text-to-speech model (Audio Studio → Speech). SceneWorks downloads the upstream Apache-2.0 AR weights on first use from OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-TTS-Realtime and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Requires the MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer codec (listed separately below) as a pinned co-requisite. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer (MOSS-TTS-Realtime codec)
components.usage: RLFQ streaming audio codec that decodes MOSS-TTS-Realtime's RVQ frames into a 24 kHz waveform (Audio Studio → Speech). SceneWorks downloads the upstream Apache-2.0 codec weights on first use from OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer as a pinned co-requisite of MOSS-TTS-Realtime and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: MMAudio (video→audio / Foley)
components.publisher: MMAudio / Sony Research · Apple · NVIDIA · V. Iashin
components.license: Research / Non-Commercial (CC-BY-NC-4.0 · Apple ML Research · MIT)
components.usage: Video→audio (Foley) model — RESEARCH / NON-COMMERCIAL USE ONLY. SceneWorks downloads on first use a five-checkpoint assembly across three repos: the MM-DiT / mel-VAE / in-repo BigVGAN weights (hkchengrex/MMAudio — CC-BY-NC-4.0, © Sony Research Inc.) with a bundled MIT Synchformer encoder (© V. Iashin), the 378px DFN5B-CLIP conditioner (apple/DFN5B-CLIP-ViT-H-14-378 — Apple ML Research Model License, research-only), and the 44.1 kHz tier's external NVIDIA BigVGAN v2 vocoder (nvidia/bigvgan_v2_44khz_128band_512x — MIT). The EFFECTIVE license is the intersection (strictest) of these: research / non-commercial only, gated by the Apple ML Research license. SceneWorks is non-commercial, so the weights are usable, but this restriction is recorded and surfaced here — a legal read is warranted before any commercial use.

Apple ML Research Model License (DFN5B-CLIP conditioner — research-only)
MIT License (NVIDIA BigVGAN v2 vocoder, 44.1 kHz tier)

components.name: Whisper base (ASR)
components.usage: Speech-to-text transcriber used as a utility dependency for audio validation / ASR round-trip checks (not a generation model). SceneWorks downloads the upstream Apache-2.0 weights on first use from openai/whisper-base and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: CLAP HTSAT-unfused (audio embedder)
components.usage: Joint audio-text embedding model used as a utility dependency for semantic audio validation (audio↔text similarity) — not a generation model. SceneWorks downloads the upstream Apache-2.0 weights on first use from laion/clap-htsat-unfused and runs them natively (Candle) on every platform. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0. Permissive — commercial use allowed.

components.name: Anima 2B
components.usage: Image generation model (base / aesthetic / turbo). Downloaded on first use from the upstream circlestone-labs/Anima repository and run natively; NOT re-hosted or redistributed by SceneWorks. NON-COMMERCIAL: the license restricts the model weights and derivatives; generated Outputs are not restricted.

components.name: Bernini
components.usage: Image + video generation model. SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy of the upstream Apache-2.0 weights (ByteDance/Bernini-Diffusers, with Wan-AI/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B components), re-hosted at SceneWorks/bernini-mlx and SceneWorks/bernini. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0.

components.name: Boogu-Image 0.1
components.usage: Image generation + instruction-edit model (Base / Turbo / Edit). SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy of the upstream Apache-2.0 weights, re-hosted at SceneWorks/boogu-image-mlx. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0.

components.name: Chroma1
components.usage: Image generation model (Base / HD / Flash). SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy of the upstream Apache-2.0 weights, re-hosted at SceneWorks/chroma1-{base,hd,flash}-mlx. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0.

components.name: FLUX.1 [dev]
components.usage: Image generation model, also the backbone for the PuLID identity lane. SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy re-hosted at SceneWorks/flux1-dev-mlx. NON-COMMERCIAL: the license restricts the model weights and derivatives; generated Outputs are not restricted.

components.name: FLUX.1 [schnell]
components.usage: Distilled few-step image generation model. SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy of the upstream Apache-2.0 weights, re-hosted at SceneWorks/flux1-schnell-mlx. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0.

components.name: FLUX.2 [dev]
components.usage: Flagship image generation model. SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy re-hosted at SceneWorks/flux2-dev-mlx. NON-COMMERCIAL: the license restricts the model weights and derivatives; generated Outputs are not restricted.

components.name: FLUX.2 klein 9B
components.usage: Distilled image generation model (klein 9B, its KV-cache variant, and the community True-V2 finetune wikeeyang/Flux2-Klein-9B-True-V2). SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy re-hosted at SceneWorks/flux2-klein-9b{,-kv}-mlx. NON-COMMERCIAL: the license restricts the model weights and derivatives; generated Outputs are not restricted.

components.name: Ideogram 4
components.usage: Image generation model (base + TurboTime distilled variant). SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy re-hosted at SceneWorks/ideogram-4-mlx and SceneWorks/ideogram-4. NON-COMMERCIAL: the agreement restricts the model weights and derivatives; generated Outputs are not restricted.

components.name: Illustrious-XL v1
components.usage: SDXL-architecture illustration model. SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy re-hosted at SceneWorks/illustrious-xl-v1-mlx. The RAIL++ license carries USE-BASED RESTRICTIONS (Attachment A) that apply to the model and its outputs.

components.name: Illustrious-XL v2
components.usage: SDXL-architecture illustration model. SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy re-hosted at SceneWorks/illustrious-xl-v2-mlx. The RAIL license carries USE-BASED RESTRICTIONS (Attachment A) that apply to the model and its outputs.

components.name: Kolors
components.usage: Bilingual image generation model. SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy re-hosted at SceneWorks/kolors-mlx. The Kolors Model License permits free commercial use below a user threshold and requires a separate licence above it — review before commercial deployment.

components.name: Krea 2
components.usage: Image generation model (undistilled Raw + distilled Turbo, plus the INT8-ConvRot tier). SceneWorks downloads on first use converted copies re-hosted on its Hugging Face org. The Krea 2 Community License is published upstream as a PDF; this notice reproduces the reference rather than the text.

components.name: Lens
components.usage: Image generation model (base + turbo). SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy of the upstream MIT weights, re-hosted at SceneWorks/lens-mlx and SceneWorks/lens-turbo-mlx. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by the MIT License.

components.name: Qwen-Image
components.usage: Image generation + Edit-2511 model (including the Lightning distilled variant). SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy of the upstream Apache-2.0 weights, re-hosted at SceneWorks/qwen-image-mlx and SceneWorks/qwen-image-edit-2511-mlx. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0.

components.name: RealVisXL
components.usage: SDXL-architecture photoreal model (base, Lightning, and the InstantID identity lane). SceneWorks downloads on first use converted copies re-hosted at SceneWorks/realvisxl-mlx and SceneWorks/realvisxl-lightning-mlx. The RAIL++ license carries USE-BASED RESTRICTIONS (Attachment A) that apply to the model and its outputs.

components.name: SANA 1.6B
components.usage: Efficient image generation model (base + Sprint distilled). SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy re-hosted at SceneWorks/Sana_1600M_1024px_mlx and SceneWorks/Sana_Sprint_1.6B_1024px_mlx; the candle backend loads the upstream Efficient-Large-Model diffusers snapshots directly.

components.name: Stable Diffusion 3.5
components.usage: Image generation model (Large / Large Turbo / Medium). SceneWorks downloads on first use converted copies re-hosted at SceneWorks/sd3.5-{large,large-turbo,medium}-mlx. The Community License is free for non-commercial use and for commercial use below an annual-revenue threshold; above it a separate Stability licence is required.

components.name: Stable Diffusion XL 1.0
components.usage: Base image generation model. SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy re-hosted at SceneWorks/sdxl-base-mlx. The RAIL++ license carries USE-BASED RESTRICTIONS (Attachment A) that apply to the model and its outputs.

components.name: SenseNova-U1 8B
components.usage: Unified multimodal image generation model (base, 8-step distilled Fast, and the Infographic V2/V3 checkpoint refreshes). SceneWorks downloads on first use converted copies re-hosted on its Hugging Face org; each snapshot ships the Apache-2.0 LICENSE reproduced here. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0.

components.name: Z-Image
components.usage: Image generation + edit model (base / Turbo / Edit). SceneWorks downloads on first use converted copies of the upstream Apache-2.0 weights, re-hosted at SceneWorks/z-image-mlx and SceneWorks/z-image-turbo-mlx. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0.

components.name: LTX-2.3 10Eros
components.usage: Video generation finetune of Lightricks LTX-2.3. Downloaded on first use from the upstream TenStrip repository; NOT re-hosted by SceneWorks. The upstream repo declares no license of its own, so the LTX-2 Community License of its base model governs — it restricts the weights and derivatives and is free for commercial use below an annual-revenue threshold.

components.name: SCAIL-2 14B
components.usage: Video generation model. SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy of the upstream MIT weights (zai-org/SCAIL-2), re-hosted at SceneWorks/scail2-mlx. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by the MIT License.

components.name: Krea Realtime 14B
components.usage: Video generation model. SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted copy of the upstream Apache-2.0 weights (krea/krea-realtime-video, a Self-Forcing distillation of Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-14B, bundled with that model's Apache-2.0 VAE / UMT5 text encoder / tokenizer), re-hosted at SceneWorks/krea-realtime-14b-mlx. Redistributed with attribution as permitted by Apache-2.0.

components.name: MiniMax-H3 (Hailuo 3.0) + Qwen3-VL-32B
components.usage: Joint video + audio generation model, in two entries sharing one component set: MiniMax-H3 (text-to-video and first/last-frame) and MiniMax-H3 References (reference-driven). On Apple Silicon, SceneWorks downloads on first use a converted MLX copy of the two diffusion transformers, re-hosted at SceneWorks/minimax-h3-mlx, plus the text encoder and both autoencoders fetched directly from the upstream MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 repository (not re-hosted). The transformer and autoencoder weights are governed by the MiniMax H3 Community License Agreement, a RESTRICTED licence and not a permissive one: it permits commercial use subject to an Acceptable Use Policy, requires attribution on redistribution, and expressly limits its Applicable Territory to the world EXCLUDING the European Union, the United Kingdom, the Republic of Korea and the United States of America. Read the full text below before use. The text encoder is byte-for-byte identical to Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct and remains under Apache-2.0; both notices apply.

documents.label: NOTICE (required by MiniMax H3 Community License §III.4)

components.name: Wan 2.1 VAE alternate decoder
components.usage: Experimental terminal decoder for compatible Krea 2 and Qwen-Image z16 generations. SceneWorks downloads only the pinned q4/vae.safetensors donor file from SceneWorks/krea-realtime-14b-mlx; it does not install or run the full Wan generator. Its Apache-2.0 terms append to the selected base model's terms, so the composition remains governed by the strictest applicable license.

components.name: Stable Video Diffusion img2vid XT
components.license: Stable Video Diffusion Non-Commercial Community License
components.usage: Image-to-video model. Downloaded on first use from the upstream Stability AI repository; NOT re-hosted by SceneWorks. The Community License restricts the weights and derivatives.

components.name: Wan2.2 VACE-Fun 14B
components.usage: Reference-guided video generation (VACE) model. Downloaded on first use from the upstream diffusers repositories; NOT re-hosted by SceneWorks. The Wan2.x weights it is built from are Apache-2.0.

components.name: AuraSR v2
components.usage: Retired GAN image upscaler. The license text remains bundled for existing installations, but current SceneWorks releases neither offer nor download AuraSR.

components.name: xinsir SDXL ControlNet utilities
components.usage: OpenPose ControlNet for the three accepted SDXL-family pose-guided models and Tile ControlNet for SDXL-architecture upscaling (shared optional components). Model Manager provisions the pinned upstream OpenPose component alongside each compatible backbone and installs Tile explicitly; SceneWorks does not re-host either artifact, and both routes resolve only installed snapshots during their jobs.

components.name: PiD pixel-diffusion decoders
components.usage: Pixel-diffusion decoders replacing the VAE decode for the FLUX / FLUX.2 / Qwen-Image / SDXL lanes (utility models). SceneWorks downloads them on first use from its re-hosts SceneWorks/pid-{flux,flux2,qwenimage,sdxl}. The NVIDIA License restricts use to non-commercial/research purposes.

components.name: Real-ESRGAN
components.usage: Image upscaler (utility model). SceneWorks installs its own ONNX export of the upstream Real-ESRGAN release weights, re-hosted at SceneWorks/real-esrgan-onnx and reproducible via scripts/spikes/sc3489_export_reference.py; the original BSD-3-Clause weights are published by Xintao Wang at the homepage below.

components.name: Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct (vision captioner)
components.usage: Vision-language captioner (utility model). Downloaded on first use from the upstream repository; NOT re-hosted by SceneWorks.

components.name: Cephes Math Library
components.usage: Ported numerical source used by the native MLX Mage Gaussian-Shading watermark implementation. The Rust port contains Cephes ndtri, erf and erfc routines and coefficient tables; its notice is included here for binary redistribution.

components.name: Mage-Flow (microsoft/Mage)
components.usage: Native MLX generation and instruction editing from the Base, RL and Turbo Mage-Flow checkpoints mirrored by SceneWorks, plus a faithful Rust/MLX source port of the microsoft/Mage reference implementation — the 4B NR-MMDiT denoiser, Mage-VAE codec, and Qwen3-VL text and vision encoder. The MIT notice is included for both weight distribution and binary redistribution.

components.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary
components.usage: The complete pronunciation dictionary is compile-time embedded in the native Kokoro speech engine and used as its out-of-vocabulary pronunciation tier.

components.name: Hugging Face Candle source
components.usage: The native FLUX VAE contains a modified vendored copy of candle-transformers source.

components.name: OpenCV drawing primitives
components.usage: InstantID keypoint rendering faithfully ports OpenCV drawing primitives and its literal sine table.

components.name: Hugging Face Diffusers source
components.usage: Native provider modules include structural Rust ports of Diffusers implementations, including ACE-Step OobleckDecoder.

components.name: JoyCaption prompt taxonomy
components.usage: The caption-type taxonomy, prompt template bodies and name option reproduced in the native captioners are near-verbatim copies of gradio-app/app.py (CAPTION_TYPE_MAP, NAME_OPTION) from fpgaminer/joycaption, which is Apache-2.0. This covers BOTH caption lanes: the Candle provider (crates/media/candle-gen/candle-gen-joycaption/src/prompt.rs) and the MLX provider (crates/media/mlx-gen/src/caption/joycaption.rs). SceneWorks MODIFIED the reproduced text: punctuation was normalized (em dash to hyphen, curly to straight quotes, backticks dropped) and upstream's "Note any watermarks, signatures, or compression artifacts." sentence was folded into the "Never mention..." clause of the Straightforward bodies. The upstream repository ships no NOTICE file. This entry covers the reproduced PROMPT CONTENT only; the JoyCaption model WEIGHTS declare no license of their own and remain undetermined.

components.name: SAM 3 (Segment Anything Model 3)
components.usage: Text-concept person segmentation (utility model) behind person tracking and Smart Select. The stock facebook/sam3 checkpoint, re-hosted by SceneWorks at SceneWorks/sam3-mlx and installed from the Model Manager. The upstream LICENSE is redistributed with the weights, as the SAM License requires.

components.name: SAM 2.1 (Segment Anything Model 2.1)
components.usage: Box-prompt person mask propagation (utility model, macOS only). Converted to MLX safetensors from Meta's official checkpoint and re-hosted by SceneWorks at SceneWorks/sam2-mlx; installed from the Model Manager. Upstream ships no LICENSE file at the pinned revision, so the Apache-2.0 text here is vendored from facebook/sam2.1-hiera-large.

components.name: YOLO11m
components.usage: Person bounding-box detection (utility model) feeding ByteTrack person tracking. Weights are derived from Ultralytics YOLO11m and re-hosted by SceneWorks as a conv+BN-fused MLX safetensors (macOS) and an ONNX export (Windows/Linux); installed from the Model Manager. SceneWorks is itself AGPL-3.0, so the copyleft terms are compatible.

documents.label: GNU Affero General Public License v3

components.name: SeedVR2-3B
components.usage: One-step diffusion super-resolution (utility model) behind the SeedVR2 image-upscale engine and video upscaling; installed from the Model Manager. The 3B fp16 DiT + VAE pair is downloaded from the third-party ComfyUI repackaging numz/SeedVR2_comfyUI, which mirrors ByteDance Seed's Apache-2.0 SeedVR2-3B release; SceneWorks does not re-host it. The Apache 2.0 text here is the standard license, matching the apache-2.0 declared by both the upstream and the mirror.

components.name: DWPose (RTMW + YOLOX, OpenMMLab mmpose)
components.usage: Whole-body pose and keypoint detection (utility model) behind the Pose Library, OpenPose control conditioning, ControlNet pose training and catalog pose analysis; installed from the Model Manager. The two ONNX graphs are the yolox_m HumanArt person detector and the RTMW-x COCO-WholeBody cocktail14 pose model, extracted verbatim from OpenMMLab's published ONNX SDK archives and re-hosted by SceneWorks at SceneWorks/dwpose-onnx with no modification. The Apache 2.0 text here is mmpose's own LICENSE file, including its Copyright 2018-2020 Open-MMLab notice. Note that mmpose's LICENSE covers the OpenMMLab project and does not itself assert terms for the HumanArt and COCO-WholeBody datasets these particular checkpoints were trained on, which carry their own terms from their own publishers.

components.name: InsightFace face analysis models (SCRFD + ArcFace)
components.usage: SCRFD face detector (scrfd_10g) and ArcFace recognition embedder (arcface_iresnet100) behind dataset face analysis, face-likeness comparison, keypoint extraction, structured catalog analysis and the identity lanes' likeness staging; staged from the SceneWorks/instantid-mlx safetensors conversion. InsightFace publishes no standalone weights license: per the verbatim upstream README terms reproduced in the notice, the CODE is MIT but models trained on InsightFace's annotated data — including SCRFD and ArcFace — are available for NON-COMMERCIAL RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY, and conversion does not change the governing terms. Commercial use requires a separate license from the InsightFace team.

documents.label: InsightFace Model License Notice (verbatim upstream terms)
